editorial_scope: Agronomy, heritage barley, farm contracts, mycotoxin evidence and malting-to-beer material transfer. AI research draft; no operational safety advice.

sources.title: Fusarium infection in malting barley drives trichothecene transfer and transformation during brewing process, impacting beer safety and composition (2026)
sources.access_scope: PubMed full abstract and detailed PMC-indexed study sections; direct PMC open returned a browser verification check. Inoculated experimental malt, not a survey of commercial beers or a safety protocol.

sources.title: Relevant Fusarium Mycotoxins in Malt and Beer (2022)
sources.access_scope: Public PMC indexed full review sections; direct page may require verification. Secondary synthesis rather than new experimental prevalence or regulatory assessment.

sources.title: Impacts of pathogen strain and barley cultivar on Fusarium head blight in barley and during malting (2024)
sources.access_scope: Full public open-access study with 2019–2021 field trials of two cultivars and seven F. graminearum isolates plus controls; strain/year/cultivar effects are trial-specific.

sources.title: A critical review of pre-harvest sprouting in barley (2026)
sources.author_label: S. I. Hull, S. Hayward, S. Orth and P. A. Swanepoel
sources.access_scope: Accessible full 2026 review of barley seed dormancy, rainfall, physiology and malting consequences; not a harvest forecast for any farm.

sources.title: Enzyme Activities Shape Malting Quality Standards (2025)
sources.access_scope: 2025 open research article indexed via PMC, emphasizing enzyme activity and genetic/environmental factors; exact detailed methods not independently reproduced.

sources.title: Understanding How Chemical Pollutants Arise and Evolve in the Brewing Supply Chain: A Scoping Review (2024)
sources.access_scope: PMC-indexed open review about storage, grain, adjuncts and contaminant fate; not a factory inspection or a statement that all beers contain contaminants.

sources.title: Modified Mycotoxins in Food: Current Evidence, Key Uncertainties, and Priorities for Risk Assessment (2026)
sources.access_scope: Public PMC indexed full sections and methods tables; direct open blocked by a browser check. Discusses modified forms and evidence gaps, not a beer-specific safety threshold.

sources.title: The barley–malt–beer chain: A process and food safety approach (2026)
sources.access_scope: Full accessible open 2026 review of grain handling, malt and brewing contaminant transfer; secondary synthesis, not validated production instructions.

sources.title: Commission Regulation (EU) 2023/915 on maximum levels for certain contaminants in food, consolidated 19 August 2026
sources.access_scope: EUR-Lex official consolidated 19 August 2026 legal text; food-matrix categories and subsequent amendments must be checked case-by-case. No global beer conformity decision.

sources.title: Commission Regulation (EU) 2024/1022 amending maximum levels of deoxynivalenol in food
sources.access_scope: Full public 2024 legal act applying from 1 July 2024; not evidence of identical limits for every cereal, beer and brewery by-product.

sources.title: Back to the future: Using ancient Bere barley landraces for a sustainable future
sources.access_scope: Full accessible open review first published online in 2023, in a 2025 issue; evidence of Scottish-island landrace cultivation and revival, not exact ancient introduction date.

sources.title: Research on cereals: Bere barley and modern varieties
sources.author_label: University of the Highlands and Islands Agronomy Institute
sources.access_scope: Public indexed university overview of Bere research, resilient traits and local supply chains; direct URL returned a 502 during follow-up, not an independent field interview.

sources.title: Hot Steep Malt Sensory Evaluation Method combined with Check-All-That-Apply (2025)
sources.author_label: Doris Häge, Felix Baumgartner and Bernd Lindemann
sources.access_scope: Full public publisher abstract describing selected heritage and modern spring barley samples; PDF methods and panel-level data not read. Sensory study is not a universal malt ranking.

sources.title: Economics of contracts in African food systems: evidence from the malt barley sector in Ethiopia (2021)
sources.author_label: Delelegne A. Tefera and Jos Bijman
sources.access_scope: Full open Ethiopia study using cross-sectional survey and statistical adjustment; Arsi contracting results not universal causal outcomes across all farmers.

sources.title: Are smallholder farmers benefiting from malt barley contract farming engagement in Ethiopia? (2022)
sources.access_scope: Full open 2022 study of 312 households with propensity-score matching on income and dietary diversity; association/estimation within its sampled setting, not a nutritional or national guarantee.

sources.title: Impact of contract farming on householders' income, intensification, and land productivity in Ethiopia (2025)
sources.access_scope: Full open 2025 study of 248 sampled households in Central and Southern Oromia with interviews, FGD and matching; local estimates and contract forms must not be generalized.

sources.title: Proteomic Insights into the Impact of Drought Stress on Barley Grain Composition and Malt Quality (2026)
sources.access_scope: PubMed full abstract of a 2026 three-cultivar drought-gradient experiment; complete paper, farm transferability and detailed protocols not reviewed.

sources.title: Mycotoxin detection in food and feed: bridging conventional analytical methods with emerging sensor-based technologies (2026)
sources.access_scope: Full open 2026 review of laboratory versus emerging sensing approaches for food and feed; not validated against every beer/ingredient matrix.

sources.title: Value chain analysis of malt barley in North western part of Ethiopia (2021)
sources.author_label: Cogent Social Sciences malt barley value-chain research authors
sources.access_scope: Full accessible report on Estie-area cooperative marketing and trust-based relationships; place-specific descriptions, not a single nationwide contract structure.
